groups.problem: Google Calendar persists the whole safeParse wrapper returned by parseRefreshTokenResponse as the credential key instead of its `.data`.
groups.rationale: All five point at the same lines and give the same root cause and the same fix (unwrap `.data`).

groups.problem: zoho-bigin passes credentialId instead of credential.userId as the userId argument to refreshOAuthTokens.
groups.rationale: Each one reports the same wrong argument. S16 reports it from the helper's signature and the rest from the call site, and one fix resolves all of them.

groups.problem: In credential-sharing mode, refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response, but callers read `.data` or token fields from it.
groups.rationale: All three come from the same root cause, the helper returning an unparsed Response. Parsing the response in the helper fixes the Google call site and the other callers.
